authorization.scope: Complete only V3 Milestone 2 development case-matrix materialization and validation.
authorization.verbatim: if everything looks great, proceed to milestone 2

case_identity.grain: One row per session_code and session_date

catalyst_policy.event_impact: Preserve the existing point-in-time CATALYST_SURPRISE engine component when present; do not derive a new directional event relation.
catalyst_policy.recent_event_rule: Include released EVENT_CASE records with released_at < decision_at, event_available_at <= decision_at, and released_at >= decision_at minus seven calendar days. Include only fixed reaction horizons whose own available_at <= decision_at.
catalyst_policy.schedule_policy: Because historical schedule availability before release is unverified, upcoming_events is empty and catalyst proximity remains UNKNOWN.

cross_market_policy.component_sources: Decision-time CROSS_MARKET_SNAPSHOT plus point-in-time FUNDAMENTAL_SNAPSHOT daily rates/USD/risk series.
cross_market_policy.rates_driver_state: Preserve the existing NOMINAL_DECOMPOSITION engine component when present; otherwise UNKNOWN.

decision_state_materialization.institutional_motive_policy: COT categories and open interest are observed/calculated; crowding, probable participation, liquidation, covering, and motive remain INFERRED.

market_mechanics_policy.instrument_identity: IC_MARKETS_MT5 XAUUSD broker CFD/feed, not the complete OTC or COMEX market
market_mechanics_policy.spread_and_tick_volume: Observed from the decision-time XAUUSD cross-market snapshot

decision_state_materialization.point_in_time_cutoff: Every nested decision fact must have available_at <= decision_at; violations block the artifact.

policy_expectations.latest_window_rule: Select all POLICY_EXPECTATION_WINDOW records sharing the latest observation_date whose available_at <= decision_at.
policy_expectations.representation: Store the eligible quarterly SOFR windows under policy_path.repricing with explicit non-FedWatch semantics.
policy_expectations.source_semantics: Atlanta Fed quarterly SOFR reference-window distribution; not exact FOMC meeting probabilities

decision_state_materialization.positioning_rule: Use only the POSITIONING_REPORT explicitly referenced by the source session/fundamental snapshot and require publication_at and available_at <= decision_at.

structure_policy.detection_policy: Preserve every detection in the decision-time STRUCTURE_SNAPSHOT; detected_at controls availability, never the earlier pivot timestamp.
structure_policy.source_hash_semantics: timeframes[].source_bar_ids_hash stores the immutable STRUCTURE_SNAPSHOT record_hash because the source bundle compacted raw lookback lineage at snapshot level; source_bar_count remains the declared timeframe count.

decision_state_materialization.synthesis_policy: Preserve existing transparent engine components as decision-time evidence. Existing score/bias is not promoted as a candidate and no component is joined to an outcome.
decision_state_materialization.unknown_policy: Missing, stale, roll-crossing, unlicensed, or unverified fields remain explicit UNKNOWN; never zero or neutral confirmation.

neutral_subsequent_behaviour.arithmetic: Use Decimal constructed from source decimal strings; quantize published USD/oz displacements to 0.00000001.
neutral_subsequent_behaviour.extreme_tie_policy: Earliest source one-minute open_time wins; if high and low first occur in the same bar, extreme_order is SAME_BAR.

fixed_horizons.15m: Close of the complete one-minute bar whose close_time is neutral_reference_at plus 15 minutes
fixed_horizons.30m: Close of the complete one-minute bar whose close_time is neutral_reference_at plus 30 minutes
fixed_horizons.5m: Close of the complete one-minute bar whose close_time is neutral_reference_at plus 5 minutes
fixed_horizons.60m: Close of the complete one-minute bar whose close_time is neutral_reference_at plus 60 minutes
fixed_horizons.SESSION_CLOSE: Close of the complete one-minute bar whose close_time is observation_end

neutral_subsequent_behaviour.full_five_minute_path: Preserve the source SESSION_CASE 08:00-12:00 local five-minute path and hashes; it remains decision_eligible=false.
neutral_subsequent_behaviour.maximum_downward_displacement: minimum one-minute low minus neutral reference; non-positive signed USD/oz
neutral_subsequent_behaviour.maximum_upward_displacement: maximum one-minute high minus neutral reference; non-negative signed USD/oz
neutral_subsequent_behaviour.neutral_measurement_bars: Complete XAUUSD one-minute bars with open_time >= 08:01 local and close_time <= 12:00 local; exactly 239 bars required.
neutral_subsequent_behaviour.neutral_reference: Open of the complete observed XAUUSD one-minute bar whose open_time is 08:01 local.

path_classification.close_location_state: Use the frozen thirds rule above.
path_classification.path_efficiency: absolute session-close displacement divided by session range; null when range is zero

neutral_subsequent_behaviour.session_range: maximum one-minute high minus minimum one-minute low

record_hash_policy: SHA-256 of canonical sorted compact JSON before record_hash is added.
validation_gates: All seven frozen input artifact SHA-256 hashes match before deserialization.
Every source SESSION_CASE has holdout_loaded=false and a session date inside development.
Exactly 1,659 rows are written: 833 London and 826 New York.
Every case_id and session_code-session_date key is unique.
Every decision-state nested fact with non-null available_at satisfies available_at <= decision_at.
Every case contains exactly six unique required structure timeframes.
Every case has 239 complete neutral-measurement one-minute bars and 48 source five-minute path points.
Every case contains all five frozen fixed horizons.
COT reports are never used before publication_at or available_at.
All output rows are DEVELOPMENT_2021_2024 and contain no 2025 or 2026 timestamps as case or outcome periods.
Outcome decision_eligible is false and research-policy execution flags are false.
Zero feature-outcome joins, relationship statistics, candidate labels, trade directions, PnL, R multiples, MFE, or MAE are produced.
Semantic validation passes independently before the bundle is accepted.
